title.en: Moved to California? Health Insurance Options 2026 | CoveredUSA
title.es: Mudarse a California? Opciones de Seguro Medico 2026 | CoveredUSA

description.en: Moving to California triggers a 60-day SEP. Enroll in Covered California or Medi-Cal. Compare options and deadlines for 2026 new residents.
description.es: Mudarse a California activa un SEP de 60 dias. Inscribase en Covered California o Medi-Cal. Compare opciones y fechas limite para nuevos residentes 2026.

h1.en: Moved to California in 2026? Here Is How to Get Health Insurance
h1.es: Se Mudo a California en 2026? Asi Obtiene Seguro Medico

subhero.en: Moving to California triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period. Most new residents can enroll in Covered California or Medi-Cal within 60 days of their move date.
subhero.es: Mudarse a California activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias. La mayoria de nuevos residentes puede inscribirse en Covered California o Medi-Cal dentro de los 60 dias de la fecha de mudanza.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your California move date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de su mudanza a California

body.en: Your 60-day Covered California Special Enrollment Period starts the day you establish California residency. For example, if you move to California on June 15, 2026, your SEP window runs June 15 through August 14, 2026. Miss that deadline and you cannot enroll in a Covered California plan until the next Open Enrollment Period beginning November 1, 2026, for 2027 coverage. Medi-Cal has no deadline and accepts applications year-round if your income qualifies.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de Covered California de 60 dias comienza el dia en que establece residencia en California. Por ejemplo, si se muda a California el 15 de junio de 2026, su ventana de SEP va del 15 de junio al 14 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde ese plazo, no puede inscribirse en un plan de Covered California hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura 2027. Medi-Cal no tiene plazo y acepta solicitudes durante todo el ano si sus ingresos califican.

quickAnswer.en: Moving to California from another state triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in Covered California, the state's ACA Marketplace. Your three main options are: (1) Covered California plan with premium tax credits if your income is 138% to 400% of the Federal Poverty Level (roughly $22,025 to $63,840 for a single person in 2026), (2) Medi-Cal, California's free Medicaid program, if your income is under 138% FPL, or (3) Cal-COBRA continuation of your prior employer plan. Most new California residents qualify for significant subsidies that make Covered California plans far cheaper than COBRA continuation.
quickAnswer.es: Mudarse a California desde otro estado activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para inscribirse en Covered California, el Mercado ACA del estado. Sus tres opciones principales son: (1) plan de Covered California con creditos fiscales de prima si su ingreso esta entre el 138% y el 400% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza (aproximadamente $22,025 a $63,840 para una persona en 2026), (2) Medi-Cal, el programa gratuito de Medicaid de California, si su ingreso es menor al 138% FPL, o (3) continuacion Cal-COBRA de su plan anterior del empleador. La mayoria de nuevos residentes de California califican para subsidios significativos que hacen los planes de Covered California mucho mas baratos que la continuacion COBRA.

introParagraphs.en: Moving to California is one of the qualifying life events that unlocks a Special Enrollment Period (SEP) outside of regular Open Enrollment. California runs its own state-based Marketplace called Covered California, which means you cannot simply transfer an ACA plan from another state. Every new California resident must enroll fresh in Covered California or Medi-Cal. The good news is that California's 2026 Covered California subsidies are among the most generous in the country at the state level, and Medi-Cal covers over 14 million Californians with free or near-free comprehensive care. California is a full Medicaid expansion state, meaning any adult with income under 138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level qualifies for Medi-Cal regardless of immigration status for those who enrolled before January 1, 2026. For most new residents arriving in 2026, the SEP window gives you 60 days from your move date to compare plans, check subsidy eligibility, and lock in coverage. Acting within this window is critical: the next chance to enroll is Open Enrollment in November 2026 for coverage starting January 1, 2027.
introParagraphs.es: Mudarse a California es uno de los eventos calificadores de vida que desbloquea un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) fuera de la Inscripcion Abierta regular. California opera su propio Mercado estatal llamado Covered California, lo que significa que no puede simplemente transferir un plan ACA de otro estado. Todo nuevo residente de California debe inscribirse de nuevo en Covered California o Medi-Cal. La buena noticia es que los subsidios de Covered California 2026 son de los mas generosos del pais a nivel estatal, y Medi-Cal cubre a mas de 14 millones de californianos con atencion medica integral gratuita o casi gratuita. California es un estado de expansion total de Medicaid, lo que significa que cualquier adulto con ingresos inferiores al 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 califica para Medi-Cal. Para la mayoria de nuevos residentes que llegan en 2026, la ventana del SEP le da 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza para comparar planes, verificar la elegibilidad de subsidios y asegurar cobertura.

introParagraphs.en: Covered California is California's official state-run ACA Marketplace. Unlike the federal healthcare.gov Marketplace used by most other states, Covered California has its own enrollment portal at coveredca.com and its own certified enrollment counselors. Covered California plans follow federal ACA metal tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) and include the same Essential Health Benefits. For 2026, Covered California's average Silver plan premium for a 40-year-old nonsmoker runs approximately $550 to $750 per month before subsidies, but premium tax credits bring most enrollees' actual costs down dramatically. Families earning 100% to 400% of the Federal Poverty Level receive subsidies, and California also offers its own state-funded subsidy (the California Premium Assistance subsidy) that fills part of the gap for incomes above 400% FPL, which the federal ACA cliff no longer covers as of January 1, 2026. Verify your projected 2026 household income carefully before enrolling: Medi-Cal income limits and Covered California subsidy thresholds both use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI), not gross wages.
introParagraphs.es: Covered California es el Mercado ACA oficial administrado por el estado de California. A diferencia del Mercado federal healthcare.gov usado por la mayoria de otros estados, Covered California tiene su propio portal de inscripcion en coveredca.com y sus propios consejeros de inscripcion certificados. Los planes de Covered California siguen los niveles de metal ACA federales (Bronce, Plata, Oro, Platino) e incluyen los mismos Beneficios de Salud Esenciales. Para 2026, la prima promedio del plan Silver de Covered California para un no fumador de 40 anos es de aproximadamente $550 a $750 por mes antes de subsidios, pero los creditos fiscales de prima reducen dramaticamente los costos reales de la mayoria de los inscritos. Las familias que ganan entre el 100% y el 400% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza reciben subsidios, y California tambien ofrece su propio subsidio estatal de Asistencia de Prima de California que cubre parte de la brecha para ingresos por encima del 400% FPL.

name.en: Establish the date of your California move
name.es: Establezca la fecha de su mudanza a California

text.en: Your 60-day SEP clock starts on the date you establish California residency. Document this date carefully. Covered California accepts proof-of-move documents dated within 90 days of your application. Keep your first California utility bill, apartment lease, or government mail showing your new California address, all dated on or near your move-in date.
text.es: El reloj de 60 dias del SEP comienza en la fecha en que establece residencia en California. Documente esta fecha cuidadosamente. Covered California acepta documentos de prueba de mudanza con fecha dentro de los 90 dias de su solicitud. Conserve su primera factura de servicios publicos de California, contrato de arrendamiento, o correo gubernamental con su nueva direccion de California.

name.es: Calcule su ingreso familiar proyectado para 2026

text.en: Use your expected income for all of 2026, not just what you have earned so far. Covered California uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI). If you are between jobs, count only the income you expect to receive the rest of the year. Income under 138% FPL, which is $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of 4 in 2026, qualifies you for free Medi-Cal. Income between 138% and 400% FPL qualifies you for Covered California premium tax credits. Check the ACA income limits table below for your household size.
text.es: Use su ingreso esperado para todo 2026, no solo lo que ha ganado hasta ahora. Covered California usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI). Si esta entre empleos, cuente solo el ingreso que espera recibir el resto del ano. Un ingreso inferior al 138% FPL, es decir $22,025 para una persona o $45,540 para una familia de 4 en 2026, lo califica para Medi-Cal gratuito.

name.es: Verifique primero la elegibilidad de Medi-Cal

text.en: Apply for Medi-Cal through coveredca.com or your county social services office at dhcs.ca.gov. Medi-Cal is California's Medicaid program and is free with comprehensive benefits for those who qualify. Medi-Cal has no enrollment deadline. If you qualify for Medi-Cal, you do not need to enroll in a Covered California plan, and Medi-Cal costs you nothing in monthly premiums.
text.es: Solicite Medi-Cal a traves de coveredca.com o la oficina de servicios sociales de su condado en dhcs.ca.gov. Medi-Cal es el programa Medicaid de California y es gratuito con beneficios integrales para quienes califican. Medi-Cal no tiene fecha limite de inscripcion. Si califica para Medi-Cal, no necesita inscribirse en un plan de Covered California.

name.en: Enroll in Covered California if you do not qualify for Medi-Cal
name.es: Inscribase en Covered California si no califica para Medi-Cal

text.en: Log in to coveredca.com, create an account, and report your move to California as your qualifying life event. Select a plan from the Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Platinum tiers. For most subsidized enrollees, Silver plans offer the best value because cost-sharing reductions on Silver plans apply at 100% to 250% FPL. Apply before Day 60 from your move date to keep your SEP valid. Coverage typically starts the first day of the month after you enroll.
text.es: Inicie sesion en coveredca.com, cree una cuenta e informe su mudanza a California como su evento calificador de vida. Seleccione un plan de los niveles Bronce, Plata, Oro o Platino. Para la mayoria de los inscritos con subsidio, los planes Silver ofrecen el mejor valor porque las reducciones de costo compartido en los planes Silver aplican del 100% al 250% FPL. Aplique antes del dia 60 desde su fecha de mudanza para mantener valido su SEP.

name.en: Gather and submit your verification documents
name.es: Recopile y envie sus documentos de verificacion

text.en: Covered California will ask you to verify your California move within a set window after you enroll. Submit proof of your new California address (utility bill, lease, government mail) dated within 90 days. Also submit proof of prior coverage from your old state if you had insurance, your Social Security numbers, and income verification. Missing the verification deadline can result in loss of your 2026 plan.
text.es: Covered California le pedira que verifique su mudanza a California dentro de un plazo establecido despues de inscribirse. Envie prueba de su nueva direccion de California (factura de servicios, contrato, correo gubernamental) con fecha dentro de los 90 dias. Tambien envie prueba de cobertura anterior de su antiguo estado si tenia seguro, numeros de Seguro Social e informacion de ingresos.

name.en: Decide whether to continue COBRA from your prior state or drop it
name.es: Decida si continuar COBRA de su estado anterior o cancelarlo

text.en: COBRA continuation from a prior employer keeps your old plan active at 102% of full premium cost, often $500 to $2,000 per month for individual coverage. Compare that cost against Covered California plans with subsidies. In most cases, new California residents with income under 400% FPL pay far less on a subsidized Covered California Silver plan. Cal-COBRA extends coverage for employees of California employers with 2 to 19 workers for up to 36 months. Federal COBRA applies to employers with 20 or more workers for 18 to 36 months.
text.es: La continuacion COBRA de un empleador anterior mantiene su plan anterior activo al 102% del costo de prima completa, a menudo $500 a $2,000 por mes para cobertura individual. Compare ese costo con los planes de Covered California con subsidios. En la mayoria de los casos, los nuevos residentes de California con ingresos inferiores al 400% FPL pagan mucho menos en un plan Silver de Covered California con subsidio.

name.en: File IRS Form 1095-A at tax time
name.es: Presente el Formulario IRS 1095-A en la temporada de impuestos

text.en: Covered California will mail you Form 1095-A each January showing your 2026 premium tax credits. Use this form to reconcile your subsidy on IRS Form 8962 when you file your federal taxes. If your actual 2026 income was higher than you estimated, you may owe some subsidy back. If it was lower, you may receive a refund.
text.es: Covered California le enviara el Formulario 1095-A cada enero mostrando sus creditos fiscales de prima de 2026. Use este formulario para reconciliar su subsidio en el Formulario IRS 8962 cuando presente sus impuestos federales. Si su ingreso real de 2026 fue mayor a lo estimado, puede que deba devolver algo del subsidio.

en: Missing the 60-day Covered California SEP window after your move date: coverage gap rules apply and you must wait until November Open Enrollment for 2027 plans
Insufficient proof of California residency: Covered California requires documents dated within 90 days showing your actual California address, not your forwarding address in another state
Reporting prior-state annual income instead of projected California-year income: Medi-Cal and subsidy eligibility depend on MAGI for the full 2026 calendar year from your California move forward
Applying without verifying Medi-Cal first: if your income qualifies for Medi-Cal, applying through a Covered California paid plan costs money you do not need to spend
Choosing a Covered California plan with a network that does not include your California providers: verify your doctors are in-network before selecting a plan at coveredca.com
es: Perder la ventana de SEP de Covered California de 60 dias despues de su fecha de mudanza: las reglas de brecha de cobertura aplican y debe esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta de noviembre para planes 2027
Prueba insuficiente de residencia en California: Covered California requiere documentos con fecha dentro de los 90 dias que muestren su direccion real en California
Reportar el ingreso anual del estado anterior en lugar del ingreso proyectado para el ano en California: la elegibilidad de Medi-Cal y del subsidio depende del MAGI para todo el ano calendario 2026
Solicitar sin verificar Medi-Cal primero: si sus ingresos califican para Medi-Cal, solicitar a traves de un plan de pago de Covered California le cuesta dinero que no necesita gastar
Elegir un plan de Covered California con una red que no incluye a sus proveedores de California: verifique que sus medicos esten en la red antes de seleccionar un plan en coveredca.com

intro.en: The most costly mistakes new California residents make when enrolling in health coverage:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen los nuevos residentes de California al inscribirse en cobertura medica:

items.en: Waiting past Day 60 from the move date. Covered California's SEP closes on Day 60. After that, only Medi-Cal remains open year-round for qualifying incomes.
items.es: Esperar mas alla del dia 60 desde la fecha de mudanza. El SEP de Covered California cierra en el dia 60. Despues de eso, solo Medi-Cal permanece abierto todo el ano para ingresos que califican.

items.en: Trying to transfer an out-of-state ACA plan to California. Covered California does not accept plan transfers. New California residents must enroll in a Covered California plan from scratch at coveredca.com.
items.es: Intentar transferir un plan ACA de otro estado a California. Covered California no acepta transferencias de planes. Los nuevos residentes deben inscribirse desde cero en coveredca.com.

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA from the prior state without comparing Covered California subsidies. For most people with income under 400% FPL, a subsidized Covered California Silver plan is dramatically cheaper than COBRA at 102% of full premium.
items.es: Continuar con COBRA del estado anterior sin comparar los subsidios de Covered California. Para la mayoria de las personas con ingresos inferiores al 400% FPL, un plan Silver de Covered California con subsidio es mucho mas barato que COBRA al 102% de la prima completa.

items.en: Forgetting to apply California's state-funded premium subsidy above 400% FPL. California offers its own Premium Assistance subsidy for incomes above the federal 400% FPL cliff (which returned January 1, 2026). Apply through coveredca.com and the state calculation happens automatically.
items.es: Olvidar solicitar el subsidio de prima estatal de California por encima del 400% FPL. California ofrece su propio subsidio de Asistencia de Prima para ingresos por encima del acantilado federal del 400% FPL (que regreso el 1 de enero de 2026).

items.en: Choosing a Covered California plan without checking the provider network. Covered California networks vary by county and carrier. Always confirm your California doctors and hospitals are in-network before selecting a plan.
items.es: Elegir un plan de Covered California sin verificar la red de proveedores. Las redes de Covered California varian por condado y aseguradora. Siempre confirme que sus medicos y hospitales de California esten en la red antes de seleccionar un plan.

items.en: Not enrolling children in Medi-Cal or CHIP (Medi-Cal for Kids) separately. Children qualify for free or low-cost Medi-Cal up to 266% FPL in 2026, which is $87,780 for a family of 4. Even if parents do not qualify for Medi-Cal, children often do.
items.es: No inscribir a los ninos en Medi-Cal o CHIP (Medi-Cal para Ninos) por separado. Los ninos califican para Medi-Cal gratuito o de bajo costo hasta el 266% FPL en 2026, que es $87,780 para una familia de 4. Aunque los padres no califiquen para Medi-Cal, los ninos a menudo si califican.

heading.en: Covered California vs Medi-Cal vs COBRA: Which Should You Choose?
heading.es: Covered California vs Medi-Cal vs COBRA: Cual Debe Elegir?

paragraphs.en: Medi-Cal is always the first check for new California residents. California expanded Medicaid fully under the ACA, so any adult with 2026 Modified Adjusted Gross Income under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level qualifies for Medi-Cal, which is free comprehensive coverage with no monthly premium. For 2026, that threshold is $22,025 for a single person or $45,540 for a family of four. Medi-Cal has no enrollment deadline and accepts applications year-round through coveredca.com or your county social services office at dhcs.ca.gov. If Medi-Cal eligibility is met, enrolling in any paid Covered California plan is redundant.
paragraphs.es: Medi-Cal es siempre la primera verificacion para nuevos residentes de California. California expandio Medicaid completamente bajo el ACA, por lo que cualquier adulto con Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado 2026 inferior al 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza califica para Medi-Cal, que es cobertura integral gratuita sin prima mensual. Para 2026, ese umbral es $22,025 para una persona o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. Medi-Cal no tiene fecha limite de inscripcion y acepta solicitudes durante todo el ano.

paragraphs.en: Covered California plans are the right path for new residents with income between 138% and 400% FPL. Within that band, federal premium tax credits (and California's state subsidy layer) reduce monthly premiums significantly. Most enrollees in this income range pay between $50 and $300 per month for a Silver plan, depending on age, household size, and county. Silver plans at 100% to 250% FPL also carry extra cost-sharing reductions that lower deductibles and copays. Enrolling in a Silver plan in this income band is almost always better than choosing a Bronze plan, because the cost-sharing reductions on Silver are extremely valuable.
paragraphs.es: Los planes de Covered California son la ruta correcta para nuevos residentes con ingresos entre el 138% y el 400% FPL. Dentro de esa franja, los creditos fiscales de prima federales (y la capa de subsidio estatal de California) reducen significativamente las primas mensuales. La mayoria de los inscritos en este rango de ingresos pagan entre $50 y $300 por mes por un plan Silver, dependiendo de la edad, el tamano del hogar y el condado.

paragraphs.en: COBRA from your prior employer makes sense only in narrow circumstances. Federal COBRA charges 102% of the full premium (employer share plus employee share plus 2% admin), which typically means $500 to $2,000 per month for individual coverage and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage. Cal-COBRA applies to California employers with 2 to 19 employees and extends coverage for up to 36 months at the same 102% cost. COBRA is worth considering only if you have ongoing care with an out-of-state specialist who is not enrolled in any California network, or if you have already met your annual deductible for the year and want to maintain it through December 31. For the vast majority of new California residents, a subsidized Covered California plan is the financially superior choice.
paragraphs.es: COBRA de su empleador anterior tiene sentido solo en circunstancias limitadas. El COBRA federal cobra el 102% de la prima completa (parte del empleador mas la del empleado mas el 2% de administracion), lo que tipicamente significa $500 a $2,000 por mes para cobertura individual. Cal-COBRA aplica a empleadores de California con 2 a 19 empleados y extiende la cobertura hasta 36 meses al mismo costo del 102%. COBRA vale la pena considerar solo si tiene atencion continua con un especialista fuera del estado que no esta inscrito en ninguna red de California.

heading.en: Medi-Cal Eligibility for New California Residents in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad de Medi-Cal para Nuevos Residentes de California en 2026

paragraphs.en: Medi-Cal is California's Medicaid program and covers more than 14 million Californians. New California residents who qualify based on income can enroll immediately upon establishing California residency. The standard adult eligibility threshold is 138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level, enforced by the California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) at dhcs.ca.gov. Children qualify at higher thresholds: up to 266% FPL ($87,780 for a family of four in 2026) through the Medi-Cal for Kids program. Pregnant individuals qualify up to 213% FPL. Seniors and persons with disabilities have separate Medi-Cal income and asset rules.
paragraphs.es: Medi-Cal es el programa Medicaid de California y cubre a mas de 14 millones de californianos. Los nuevos residentes de California que califican segun sus ingresos pueden inscribirse de inmediato al establecer la residencia en California. El umbral de elegibilidad estandar para adultos es el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026, aplicado por el Departamento de Servicios de Atencion Medica de California (DHCS) en dhcs.ca.gov. Los ninos califican con umbrales mas altos: hasta el 266% FPL ($87,780 para una familia de cuatro en 2026) a traves del programa Medi-Cal para Ninos.

paragraphs.en: Starting January 1, 2026, Medi-Cal reinstated asset limit checks for new applicants, with a cap of $130,000 in assets for an individual and $195,000 for a couple. Standard adult MAGI-based Medi-Cal still has no asset test. Medi-Cal uses MAGI income, meaning it includes wages, self-employment income, Social Security benefits, and unemployment compensation. To apply for Medi-Cal as a new California resident, visit coveredca.com (which routes to Medi-Cal automatically if you qualify) or apply directly through your county social services office. Coverage for Medi-Cal enrollees typically starts the first day of the month after a complete application is received.
paragraphs.es: A partir del 1 de enero de 2026, Medi-Cal reinstalo las verificaciones de limites de activos para nuevos solicitantes, con un limite de $130,000 en activos para un individuo y $195,000 para una pareja. El Medi-Cal estandar para adultos basado en MAGI aun no tiene prueba de activos. Medi-Cal usa el ingreso MAGI, lo que significa que incluye salarios, ingresos de trabajo independiente, beneficios del Seguro Social y compensacion por desempleo.

heading.en: California's State-Funded Subsidy for Incomes Above 400% FPL
heading.es: El Subsidio Estatal de California para Ingresos por Encima del 400% FPL

paragraphs.en: California offers a state-funded Premium Assistance subsidy for residents with income above 400% of the Federal Poverty Level. At the federal level, the ACA subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026, after enhanced premium tax credits under the American Rescue Plan and Inflation Reduction Act expired. Federal subsidies now cut off at 400% FPL, $63,840 for a single person or $132,000 for a family of four in 2026. California's state program fills part of this gap by providing state-funded help to Californians in the 400% to 600% FPL range, reducing the premium shock that residents in states without state-funded supplements face. New California residents above 400% FPL should apply through coveredca.com and the state calculation is applied automatically during plan selection.
paragraphs.es: California ofrece un subsidio estatal de Asistencia de Prima para residentes con ingresos por encima del 400% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. A nivel federal, el acantilado de subsidio del ACA regreso el 1 de enero de 2026, despues de que expiraron los creditos de prima mejorados bajo el Plan de Rescate Americano y la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. Los subsidios federales ahora se cortan al 400% FPL: $63,840 para una persona o $132,000 para una familia de cuatro en 2026. El programa estatal de California llena parte de esta brecha al proporcionar ayuda estatal a los californianos en el rango del 400% al 600% FPL.

heading.en: Children's Coverage After Moving to California in 2026
heading.es: Cobertura para Ninos Despues de Mudarse a California en 2026

paragraphs.en: Children who move to California with their families have two strong coverage options: Medi-Cal for Kids (the CHIP program integrated into Medi-Cal in California) and a Covered California family plan. Medi-Cal covers children up to 266% FPL in 2026, which is $87,780 per year for a family of four. Children who qualify for Medi-Cal can enroll year-round at no cost. For families whose income is above 266% FPL, children can be added to a Covered California family plan during the same 60-day SEP that covers the parents. California does not have a separate branded CHIP program (unlike states such as Illinois with AllKids or Colorado with CHP+): child coverage is folded into Medi-Cal. The qualifying life event SEP for the move covers the entire household.
paragraphs.es: Los ninos que se mudan a California con sus familias tienen dos solidas opciones de cobertura: Medi-Cal para Ninos (el programa CHIP integrado en Medi-Cal en California) y un plan familiar de Covered California. Medi-Cal cubre ninos hasta el 266% FPL en 2026, que es $87,780 por ano para una familia de cuatro. Los ninos que califican para Medi-Cal pueden inscribirse durante todo el ano sin costo. Para las familias con ingresos por encima del 266% FPL, los ninos se pueden agregar a un plan familiar de Covered California durante el mismo SEP de 60 dias que cubre a los padres.

en.question: What is the SEP window after moving to California?
en.answer: Moving to California from another state triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) for Covered California. Your SEP starts on the date you establish California residency and ends 60 days later. For example, a June 15, 2026 move gives you a SEP from June 15 through August 14, 2026. Covered California also allows you to report a move up to 60 days in advance if you know your move date in advance. Medi-Cal has no such deadline and accepts applications year-round for those who qualify based on income.

en.question: How do I document a move to California for Covered California enrollment?
en.answer: Covered California accepts proof of California residency documents dated within 90 days of your application. Acceptable documents include: a California utility bill (gas, electric, water), a signed California lease or rental agreement, a California driver license or state ID showing your new address, or official government mail addressed to your California address. You also need to provide the date of your move to establish the start of your 60-day SEP window. Submit these through your coveredca.com account after selecting a plan. Missing the verification deadline can result in termination of your 2026 Covered California enrollment.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day Covered California SEP after my move?
en.answer: If you miss the 60-day SEP window after moving to California, you typically cannot enroll in a Covered California plan until the next Open Enrollment Period, which begins November 1, 2026 for coverage starting January 1, 2027. Medi-Cal is the exception: it accepts applications year-round for those with income under 138% FPL ($22,025 for a single person in 2026). If a second qualifying life event occurs, such as a marriage, job loss, or birth, you would get a new 60-day SEP at that time.

en.question: Can I transfer my out-of-state ACA plan to Covered California?
en.answer: No. ACA plans are state-specific and cannot be transferred across state lines. Moving to California terminates eligibility for your previous state's Marketplace plan. You must enroll fresh in Covered California using the 60-day move SEP. This is true even if your prior plan was through the federal healthcare.gov Marketplace or another state's exchange. Your new Covered California plan typically starts on the first day of the month after you enroll.

en.question: Do I qualify for Medi-Cal after moving to California?
en.answer: Many new California residents qualify for Medi-Cal immediately upon establishing California residency. California is a full Medicaid expansion state. The 2026 income limit for standard adult Medi-Cal is 138% of the Federal Poverty Level: $22,025 per year for a single person, $29,820 for a household of 2, or $45,540 for a family of 4. Children qualify up to 266% FPL and pregnant individuals up to 213% FPL. Apply through coveredca.com or your county social services office. Medi-Cal eligibility is year-round with no enrollment deadline.

en.question: Should I keep COBRA from my prior employer after moving to California?
en.answer: COBRA continuation from a prior employer is rarely the best financial choice after moving to California. Federal COBRA charges 102% of the full premium (both employer and employee shares plus a 2% admin fee), typically $500 to $2,000 per month for an individual. Cal-COBRA applies to California employers with 2 to 19 employees for up to 36 months at the same cost. Most new California residents with income under 400% FPL will pay far less on a subsidized Covered California Silver plan. COBRA is worth keeping only if you have active ongoing treatment with a provider not in any California network, or if your annual deductible is substantially met and you want to preserve it through December 31.

en.question: What are my children's health coverage options after moving to California?
en.answer: Children who move to California qualify for Medi-Cal up to 266% FPL in 2026, which is $87,780 per year for a family of four. California integrates its CHIP program fully into Medi-Cal under the Medi-Cal for Kids umbrella, so there is no separate CHIP enrollment. Children can be enrolled in Medi-Cal year-round at no cost if they qualify based on family income. For families above 266% FPL, children are added to a Covered California family plan using the same 60-day move SEP. The Covered California family plan covers all household members under one enrollment.

en.question: Does California offer subsidies above the 400% FPL cliff?
en.answer: Yes. California is one of the few states that offers a state-funded Premium Assistance subsidy for residents with income above the federal 400% FPL subsidy cutoff. The federal ACA subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026, after enhanced premium tax credits expired. California's state program partially offsets this for Californians in the 400% to 600% FPL range. Apply through coveredca.com and the state subsidy calculation applies automatically. This state-level cushion is unique to California and does not exist in states using the federal healthcare.gov Marketplace.

es.question: Cual es la ventana del SEP despues de mudarse a California?
es.answer: Mudarse a California desde otro estado activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias para Covered California. Su SEP comienza en la fecha en que establece residencia en California y termina 60 dias despues. Por ejemplo, una mudanza el 15 de junio de 2026 le da un SEP del 15 de junio al 14 de agosto de 2026. Covered California tambien le permite reportar una mudanza con hasta 60 dias de anticipacion. Medi-Cal no tiene ese plazo y acepta solicitudes durante todo el ano para quienes califican segun sus ingresos.

es.question: Como documento una mudanza a California para la inscripcion en Covered California?
es.answer: Covered California acepta documentos de prueba de residencia en California con fecha dentro de los 90 dias de su solicitud. Los documentos aceptables incluyen: una factura de servicios publicos de California, un contrato de arrendamiento firmado, una licencia de conducir de California o ID estatal con su nueva direccion, o correo gubernamental oficial dirigido a su direccion de California. Tambien necesita proporcionar la fecha de su mudanza para establecer el inicio de su ventana de SEP de 60 dias. Presente estos documentos a traves de su cuenta de coveredca.com despues de seleccionar un plan.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de Covered California de 60 dias despues de mi mudanza?
es.answer: Si pierde la ventana de SEP de 60 dias despues de mudarse a California, normalmente no puede inscribirse en un plan de Covered California hasta el siguiente Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta, que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura que inicia el 1 de enero de 2027. Medi-Cal es la excepcion: acepta solicitudes durante todo el ano para personas con ingresos inferiores al 138% FPL ($22,025 para una persona en 2026). Si ocurre un segundo evento calificador de vida, como matrimonio, perdida de empleo o nacimiento, obtendria un nuevo SEP de 60 dias en ese momento.

es.question: Puedo transferir mi plan ACA de otro estado a Covered California?
es.answer: No. Los planes ACA son especificos de cada estado y no se pueden transferir a traves de las fronteras estatales. Mudarse a California termina la elegibilidad para el plan del Mercado de su estado anterior. Debe inscribirse de nuevo en Covered California usando el SEP de mudanza de 60 dias. Esto es cierto incluso si su plan anterior era a traves del Mercado federal healthcare.gov o el intercambio de otro estado. Su nuevo plan de Covered California generalmente comienza el primer dia del mes despues de inscribirse.

es.question: Califico para Medi-Cal despues de mudarme a California?
es.answer: Muchos nuevos residentes de California califican para Medi-Cal de inmediato al establecer residencia en California. California es un estado de expansion total de Medicaid. El limite de ingresos 2026 para el Medi-Cal estandar para adultos es el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: $22,025 por ano para una persona, $29,820 para un hogar de 2, o $45,540 para una familia de 4. Los ninos califican hasta el 266% FPL y las personas embarazadas hasta el 213% FPL. Solicite a traves de coveredca.com o la oficina de servicios sociales de su condado.

es.question: Debo mantener COBRA de mi empleador anterior despues de mudarme a California?
es.answer: La continuacion COBRA de un empleador anterior rara vez es la mejor opcion financiera despues de mudarse a California. El COBRA federal cobra el 102% de la prima completa (partes del empleador y el empleado mas una tarifa administrativa del 2%), tipicamente $500 a $2,000 por mes para un individuo. La mayoria de los nuevos residentes de California con ingresos inferiores al 400% FPL pagaran mucho menos en un plan Silver de Covered California con subsidio. COBRA vale la pena mantener solo si tiene tratamiento continuo activo con un proveedor que no esta en ninguna red de California.

es.question: Cuales son las opciones de cobertura medica para mis hijos despues de mudarnos a California?
es.answer: Los ninos que se mudan a California califican para Medi-Cal hasta el 266% FPL en 2026, que es $87,780 por ano para una familia de cuatro. California integra su programa CHIP completamente en Medi-Cal bajo el paraguas de Medi-Cal para Ninos, por lo que no hay inscripcion separada de CHIP. Los ninos pueden inscribirse en Medi-Cal durante todo el ano sin costo si califican segun el ingreso familiar. Para las familias por encima del 266% FPL, los ninos se agregan a un plan familiar de Covered California usando el mismo SEP de mudanza de 60 dias.

es.question: Ofrece California subsidios por encima del acantilado del 400% FPL?
es.answer: Si. California es uno de los pocos estados que ofrece un subsidio estatal de Asistencia de Prima para residentes con ingresos por encima del limite de subsidio federal del 400% FPL. El acantilado de subsidio del ACA federal regreso el 1 de enero de 2026, despues de que expiraron los creditos de prima mejorados. El programa estatal de California compensa parcialmente esto para los californianos en el rango del 400% al 600% FPL. Solicite a traves de coveredca.com y el calculo del subsidio estatal se aplica automaticamente.
